newsitem.title: USA: HEICO sees higher earnings for FY1996.
newsitem.headline: HEICO sees higher earnings for FY1996.

text.p: HEICO Corp said Wednesday it expects to report significantly higher sales and earnings for the year ended Oct. 31, 1996.

Based on preliminary information, the company said sales from continuing operations are expected to total $34.4 million, up 34 percent from fiscal 1995 sales from continuing operations of $25,613,000.
The company said final audited fiscal 1996 statements are expected to be available in late December.

The company said net income from continuing operations is expected to equal $3.6 million, or $0.67 per share, up over 150 percent from last year's net income from continuing operations of $1,437,000, or $0.30 per share.

The company said it expects to report net income from discontinued operations of $6.2 million, or $1.16 per share, including a gain of $5.3 million, or $0.98 per share, from the sale of the company's former MediTek Health Corp subsidiary in July 1996.
For the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996, the company said it sees sales of $11.4 million, up 65 percent from $6,923,000 in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1995.

Net income from continuing operations for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996 is expected to equal $1.3 million, or $0.25 per share, up over 70 percent from $753,000, or $0.9 per share, in the fourth quarter of last year.
